lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple high-intensity circular spots arranged in semi-regular vertical columns along the lateral flank posterior to the branchial region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with high-luminance blobs, creating a grid-like nodal distribution across the visible flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal linear ridges are visible across the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a light-to-shadow vertical gradient from top to bottom.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple Gnathanodon speciosus (yellow pilot fish) and a single Echeneidae (remora) in close proximity to the dermal surface.
